text:
maria ramos: Heads-up — a community user asked for a C# example for the Optimize Toolkit (batching + KV prefetch + quant profiles). We only have Go/JS/Rust. I opened a tiny PR to add a C# snippet and fix an outdated SDK ctor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812

omar z.: Nice. I can draft a minimal C# async snippet. Question: prefer ContinuousBatcher pattern or show the legacy Batcher for parity?

maria ramos: Make ContinuousBatcher primary (recommended). Add a one-line legacy mapping to help migrating users. Also recommend the `shortseq` quant profile for short prompts.

cheng li: CI note: the draft referenced an external sample url. Change to an internal example path so snippet extraction works, e.g. `/examples/optimize/csharp/kv_prefetch/Program.cs`.

devex-sam: UX ask: include a 2-row mini table (legacy vs prefetch+continuous) with tokens/sec and p95 latency. Keep it tiny and labeled "illustrative". Also add a microbench command users can run locally.

omar z.: Will do. Proposed microbench: `dotnet run --project examples/optimize/csharp/KVPrefetch -- --profile shortseq --batch continuous`

omar z.: Draft C# snippet (async, minimal):
```csharp
using Redwood;
using Redwood.Optimize;

var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
var cb = new ContinuousBatcher(client).WithKVPrefetch();
var resp = await cb.GenerateAsync("Summarize: ...", new GenerateOptions { QuantProfile = "shortseq" });
Console.WriteLine(resp.Text);
```

maria ramos: Nice and concise. Please add a fallback note: "If KV prefetch misses the local cache, the request falls back to the single-path call; expect ~1.7-1.9x p95 latency."

cheng li: Left a small PR comment requesting the one-line legacy mapping: `// Legacy: new Batcher(client) -> ContinuousBatcher(client).WithAutoFlush(false)` and a link to the Dedicated docs for pinning quant profiles: `/dedicated/configure-quant-profiles`

omar z.: Added the legacy mapping comment and the Dedicated crosslink. Also switched the snippet extraction tag to the internal path. Pushed update.
